description:
Music Switcher
With sample custom music from Honkai: Star Rail

Music Switcher lets you decide what music plays, when, and for whom — without touching your save file.
Most noticeably, combat is no longer silent! Expect some epic boss music when you fight REDACTED opponents.

Adds a settings panel (Top-left on the main menu -> Mod Settings -> "Music Switcher") where you pick the rule set for every faction and situation:

Vanilla behaves as if this mod doesn't exist for the faction.
Custom always play the custom tracks supplied by Music Switcher (or supplied by the user/other mods, following instructions below).
Both randomly flip between Custom and Vanilla each time a track would start.

Can work with other music packs that supply music (unless they also hijack the music player)

Music Switcher only modifies which music ID is requested; it does not replace existing audio files.
Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.

Dependencies: LunaLib and LazyLib

Note that Sindrian Diktat is left vanilla by default because I couldn't find HSR tracks fitting their vibes, but feel free to use some of your own. See below or the readme file or the in-game instructions in Lunasettings on how to add your custom music.

For players interested in using self-supplied tracks:

Spoiler
You can replace sample custom music in this mod with anything you like (file must be in .ogg format), or add it to the shuffle.

To replace:
Simply navigate to the /Starsector/mods/Music Switcher/sounds folder, find whatever .ogg file you want to replace, delete it, rename your own .ogg file to what it used to be and paste in its place. Note that .mp4 and other formats are not recognized by the game.

To add multiple tracks to a shuffle:
1 Do the same as above, but since only one file can use the old file's name, you need to rename the rest into for example MyMusicFile2.ogg
2 Open /Starsector/mods/Music Switcher/data/config/sounds.json with a notepad, Ctrl+F to search for the first file name, for example
"CustomDiktatEncounterHostile.ogg",
and add
"MyMusicFile2.ogg",
one line below it (inside the overarching "files":[   ] bracket)
Don't lose the comma at the end of each line, tweak the volume if you want to.

Restart the game to take effect.
If you fiddled with sounds.json and the game refuses to start and gives you an error message, you probably missed/duplicated a comma or a bracket.

For modders interested in supplying combat music for your mod's faction:

Spoiler
You can add customized combat music and let Music Switcher play it when the player fights your mod's faction:

1 Add the following to your myfaction.faction file
"music": {"combat": "Custom_music_myfaction_combat"}
2 Add the following to your mod's sounds.json (If you don't haven one, create data/config/sounds.json and then add)
"music":
{
"Custom_music_myfaction_combat":
[
{
"source":"sounds/Combat/",
"volume":0.80,
"file":"MyMusicFile2.ogg",
}
]
}
3 Create a sounds/Combat/ folder, put MyMusicFile2.ogg inside.
4 Instruct the player to use Music Switcher if they want to hear custom music while fighting your faction. This would be a soft dependency, meaning that they can plug out Music Switcher at any time, and other functions of your mod will be unaffected.

discordPostHtml:
This mod allows you to mix and match custom music with vanilla music using LunaLib's options (startup menu screen, top left corner)

Only modifies what music to play, okay to add/remove mid-save
Dependencies: LunaLib and LazyLib
Compatible with other music packs

If you already know how to change music with** sounds.json **, what this mod adds is the option to:

1 Customize combat music
2 Differentiate music for Player Faction / independent / [REDACTED] (all use the default faction music in vanilla).

Custom music is, by default, sample tracks from Honkai: Star Rail

See the readme file or the forum link on how to use your own music, and for modders how to incorporate combat music for your faction.

v1.7: 27/07/2025-Silence/crash should be all gone now: fixed more issues introduced in 1.5 and learnt not to trust GPT to freely overhaul my code.

v1.5: 19/06/2025-Overhauled the code for better compatibility. Should also run a bit faster and eat less RAM.
